title: Earning Income, Gifts, Job Skills, Wants and Needs
seo_title: Kindergarten Personal Financial Literacy Worksheets: Income and Gifts (TEKS K.9)
standard_text: K.9A identify ways to earn income; K.9B differentiate between money received as income and money received as gifts; K.9C list simple skills required for jobs; K.9D distinguish between wants and needs and identify income as a source to meet one's wants and needs
meta_desc: Free kindergarten personal financial literacy worksheets for Texas TEKS K.9: ways to earn income, income or a gift, job skills, and wants and needs. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Income is earned by working; a gift is given.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • People earn income by working at jobs.
  • A gift is given to you. It is not earned.
  • Jobs need skills, like cooking or driving safely.
  • A need is something you must have. A want is nice to have. Income pays for needs first.

Examples

Example

$5 for raking leaves

earned by working

Answer: income

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Calling a gift incomeIncome is earned.
Mixing up wants and needsAsk: can I live without it?
Thinking money just appearsPeople work to earn it.

faq.a: Differentiate between money received as income and money received as gifts.
List simple skills required for jobs.
Distinguish between wants and needs and identify income as a source to meet one's wants and needs.
